# Burrow v0.1.0 — source preview

This tag is an early source-code preview and is not an installable end-user
release. No application or disk-image artifact is attached.

Development has continued on `main` with additional security hardening,
packaging checks and public-repository preparation. Use the latest revision of
`main` for review and development; do not redistribute this preview as a
finished Burrow build.

## Scope of the preview

- macOS 13 Ventura or later
- Apple Silicon (`arm64`) only
- Burrow source under MIT, with bundled components retaining their own licenses
- Initial Tauri trust-boundary, dependency-audit and bundled-resource checks

See `README.md`, `SECURITY.md`, `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and `RELEASING.md` in
the current repository for the maintained documentation.
